response.justification: Strong, long-tenured individual contributor with 15+ years across web, mobile, desktop and embedded, and genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth (built the Trial test runner and Fluent-Asserts for D, ran GitLab/CI/deploy infrastructure, taught Selenium/TDD courses). However, the role is a people-leadership position and the resume shows no evidence of the required 2 years of people management — no direct reports, hiring, performance reviews, or one-on-ones are mentioned. Staff Engineer titles and a solo open-source founder role suggest technical influence but not organizational leadership or roadmap ownership for a team. Mobile-platform exposure is real but dated and limited (iOS/tvOS work in 2015-16). Worth a screening call to probe for unstated mentoring/lead experience, but the management gap is the deciding factor.
strengths: Deep developer-tooling and test-infrastructure work (test runner, assertion library, CI/CD, DevOps)
15+ years of hands-on engineering across many languages, platforms and domains
Proven knowledge-sharing: conference talks, multi-day workshops, and a Selenium/TDD course
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports
No evidence of team roadmap ownership or leading organizational change
Mobile-platform experience is limited and roughly a decade old

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure depth
